about: Iruma-kun story Short: his parents sell his soul to a demon - who only wants a grandson; Iruma can't say no, gets enrolled at a demon school where humans are food, and must never be found out. The drop throws him into Babyls (summoning rituals, the Gorgon snake, dragons, the whole class calling him amazing) and ends with him marvelling he became a demon's grandson.
